title: frangula occidentalis
intro: Frangula occidentalis, commonly known as Cascara Sagrada, is a flowering plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is a natural laxative used in herbal medicine to support digestive health, and its health benefits include relieving constipation, regulating bowel movements, and soothing digestive issues such as irritable bowel syndrome. The therapeutic actions of Cascara Sagrada include its ability to stimulate bowel motility, reduce inflammation, and protect against gastrointestinal infections. The bioactive constituents of Frangula occidentalis include anthraquinones, such as aloe-emodin and rhein, which contribute to its laxative properties and anti-inflammatory effects.
